about_the_game:
All of the current and future music used in the adult visual novel Her Last Piece.

Designed, crafted and mastered by the legendary Canadian brothers Sanityzer and Monty P, these tracks include the full feeling of the story of Arvenia within Her Last Piece.

All profits of this soundtrack will go to the artist.

Tracks featured:

Her Last Piece (Main theme)

The Queen's Eyes

Forsaken Throne

Whispers Beneath the Crown

Gilded Chains

Thorns Beneath Silk

Devotion Unspooled

Velvet Embrace

Velvet Guillotine

Clockwork Jest

Marionette's Dirge

Splintered Jest

Serenity Lake

Cold Water Stare

Love at Dawn

Fhaust's Theme

Steps Behind the Veil

Twilight Servitude

The Queen's Sorrow

Arvenia's Shadow

Kingdoms Left to Rot
